text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I lost...?! 
Me... Seriously...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This gotta be a dream.
Some kind of nightmare...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
My, there is no dream more wonderful than this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In a mile race, I might've lost.
But at 2,000m...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka had grown stronger through the Derby.
Yet Daiwa Scarlet put on a display of growth that surpassed even that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you've really built up your stamina...
I always knew you had more than me, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... she doesn't even show a hint of fatigue.
Just what kind of training did she go through?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I just did steady distance running. Morning, noon, and night,
in the smartest way possible, and more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's it? Boring.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right, it's boring! But I made sure to do that absolute most boring part properly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "That is—my weapon. Something you definitely don't have, and something you could never do."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's because I honed that skill that I was able to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guh, since I get bored of things easily, you might be right
that I won't be able to pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet smirked triumphantly, and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is only our first race.
Next up is the year-end Arima Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At 2,500 meters,
my strengths will shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the absolute best version of me.
Well? Scared?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm scared!
Today was just a fluke, a total fluke!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, before that,
I plan on entering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"If your schedule allows, come there too.
I'll take you on as many times as it takes."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
OK, fine by me. Not sure about the Queen Elizabeth Cup,
but the year-end Arima Kinen! I'll turn the tables there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, this time it's your turn to chase me.
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-he-heh-heh, hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking genuinely happy from the bottom of her heart, Daiwa Scarlet walked away with light, cheerful steps.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Losing feels pathetic, sure, but...
I had a blast to my heart's content. Somehow... it ain't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I compete against her, I forget everything
and just lose myself in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
And that ain't all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She probably sees it now.
Maybe even more clearly than I do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Nah, it's nothin'. Just let me face her in the Arima, will ya?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I'll be able to see what's truly important there.
For what lies ahead for me."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's head to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank you, Trainer.
Man, she's always so loud, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the rest of this year.
Let's turn this into an all-out match race.
